candidate_axis_distinction.region_comembership_axis: AcceptedV2 canonical regions, exactly 4096 rows per scene
candidate_axis_distinction.figurines_d3_axis: all scale-major valid-anchor regions, approximately valid_anchor_count_times_three
candidate_axis_distinction.forbidden_claim: The previously observed Figurines D3=0.771 is not an upper bound for the 4096-row AcceptedV2 RegionCoMembership method.
candidate_axis_distinction.required_target_report: Any eventual target run must separately report its AcceptedV2-axis support/oracle ceiling when labels are opened under the one authorized final evaluation; until then no target ceiling is claimed.

source_accepted_v2_candidate_graph_oracl.semantics: Oracle retains exactly candidate edges whose endpoints share one positive dominant source instance; it measures candidate connectivity only, not model accuracy.

target_prerequisites: all four fixed source-train and two fixed source-validation RegionCoMembership authorities exist and pass strict SHA reload
the topology-consistent 4+2 pilot selects a non-epoch-zero checkpoint and satisfies its frozen source-validation promotion gate
the target scene has a query-independent AcceptedV2 sparse authority, matching support graph, factorized primitive state and adaptive typed-context authority
if the target AcceptedV2 chain is absent, build capability then support graph then AcceptedV2 then adaptive typed context without reading target queries labels masks or metrics
source parity proves the feature-only materializer emits pair_indices and all 15 features bitwise equal to the instance-supervised builder

text_seed_rule.selection: the AcceptedV2 canonical region with the highest frozen O0 query score
text_seed_rule.connected_filter: retain the thresholded RegionCoMembership connected component containing that unique seed

execution_order_after_promotion: materialize one query-independent target pair-feature authority
run the single frozen checkpoint and source-validation-selected global threshold
read frozen O0 scores only to select the unique seed per query
run the frozen benchmark evaluator once and report the AcceptedV2-axis support ceiling separately
